ContentEvent.description: Represents an event from the On Demand Feed, Base Feed, or Enriched Feed. The message parameter contains the actual content. The requester parameter will only be present in messages sent from the On Demand workflow. For the Base Feed and Enriched Feed workflows, the 'messages' array will contain at most a single message. For the On Demand workflow, the'messages' array may contain multiple messages.

tags.name: Initiating Chats in IB
tags.description:
Post structured and/or unstructured content to one or more users and chat rooms from a registered system.
 * The sender has to be enabled for both IB API and Chat Initiation.
 * The sender can only be from the same firm as the credentials.
 * A valid chat room recipient is a chat room which the sender is a member of.
 * A valid user recipient is a user with a valid uuid.
 * The maximum number of recipients is 50.
 * The message has to be encoded in UTF-8 and the maximum length is 250 characters.
 * The sender can receive up to 1 Chat Initiation popup in IB for every 2 seconds.
 * A user can have a maximum of 5 chat initiation widget windows open at a given time.

get.summary: Subscribe to an IB Feed Stream
get.description: Opens a long-lived HTTP connection and streams events as newline-delimited JSON. The connection remains open until the client disconnects or the server terminates the stream. Each line is a complete JSON object representing a single event, delivered as a JSON object. For the Base Feed and Enriched Feed workflows, the 'messages' array in a ContentEvent will contain a single message. In the On Demand workflow, the 'messages' array may contain multiple messages.

parameters.name: sendContentEvents
parameters.description: Determines if Content Events are being sent in stream. Accepts truthy and falsy values, for example "true" and "false" respectively. If a value that can't be interpreted as truthy or falsy is supplied, an HTTP response with error code 400 will be delivered.

parameters.name: sendIdeaDrawerFeedbackEvents
parameters.description: Determines if Idea Drawer Feedback Events are being sent in stream. Information regarding Idea Drawer can be found on this [page](https://developer.bloomberg.com/pages/products/ib-connect/doc/idea-drawer). Accepts truthy and falsy values, for example "true" and "false" respectively. If a value that can't be interpreted as truthy or falsy is supplied, an HTTP response with error code 400 will be delivered.

parameters.name: sendRoomMembershipEvents
parameters.description: Determines if Room Membership Events (such as users joining or leaving a room) are being sent in stream. Accepts truthy and falsy values, for example "true" and "false" respectively. If a value that can't be interpreted as truthy or falsy is supplied, an HTTP response with error code 400 will be delivered.

parameters.name: backfillId
parameters.description: Specifies the event after which streaming will resume. Every message will have a backfillId field. Use this ID to request for a backfill. If the backfill ID is older than 5 minutes an HTTP response with error code 410 will be delivered. In this case you can try reconnecting without a backfillId query parameter to receive real-time events. If the backfill ID is invalid an HTTP response with error code 400 will be delivered.

Transfer-Encoding.description: Indicates the response is delivered as a chunked stream of newline-delimited JSON events.

tokens.text: A big concern for prospective Tesla owners is whether the battery will need replacing.
Tesla battery replacements can cost over $20,000

, Tesla owners have reported. When one Canadian Tesla owner's battery died in 2023, the company told him a replacement would cost $26,000. Another owner in Scotland received a bill equivalent to $21,000 USD to replace his Tesla's battery after it got damaged by rain.
Batteries degrade at varying rates based on a number of factors, like how the EV was charged, what type of environment it was driven in, and more. Auto expert
previously told Business Insider that, the
Tesla batteries are easily damaged and difficult to repair or even assess
. Munro even said Tesla's Model Y battery has "zero repairability" following a collision.
In 2019, Elon Musk said it would cost $5,000 to $7,000 to replace a Tesla battery module; however, Tesla owners who have been quoted or billed for battery replacements cite far higher costs.
